mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.0% for three consecutive months, it indicates restrictive monetary policy that suppresses corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS > 3.0% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint increases in HOUST and RSAFS occur in >50% of months but 20-day returns are negative in >60% of those instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) triggers Federal Reserve accommodation that lowers real interest rates and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >60% of months when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1200 thousand units signals strong residential construction activity that stimulates economic growth and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of months when HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 60 days reflects robust manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of months when INDPRO increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation that prompts aggressive Fed tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of months when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% (y/y), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 60 days indicates improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate revenues, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of months when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
